name: Area Chart
description: Stacked, overlapping or 100% areas in a card, with a crosshair tooltip and a legend of totals.

props.name: series
props.type: { name: string; data: number[]; color?: string }[]
props.description: One entry per area, with a value per label. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per point along the bottom. Crowded labels thin out.

props.name: mode
props.description: Pile the series up, lay each from zero, or show each as a share of the total.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip and legend. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title, one per label, e.g. "March 2026".

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend with each series' total under the plot.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value: 0.082 is +8.2%.

props.name: invertDelta
props.description: Treat a fall as good, for costs or wait times.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. "this week".

props.name: note
props.description: A muted line under the value.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the legend under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
